## Summary

Describe the problem, the smallest solution, and any scientific, compatibility,
or security impact.

## Validation

- [ ] I added or updated tests for major functionality and bug fixes.
- [ ] Ruff formatting and lint checks pass for maintained package/test code, compliance checkers, and fuzz configuration.
- [ ] `pytest --cov=pdeobs --cov-branch` passes without reducing statement or branch coverage.
- [ ] Every commit contains my matching DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer.
- [ ] At least one human who is not the author has approved this change.
- [ ] I considered security, trust-boundary, and reproducible-build effects.
- [ ] Generated documentation is current, when applicable.
- [ ] I added a `CHANGELOG.md` entry for user-visible behavior.
- [ ] I did not add datasets, checkpoints, predictions, credentials, or private cluster configuration.
